authored_scope: A02 40 additional individually scripted worksite locations LV_081-LV_120; cumulative 120/200

entries.title: Spindle hot-bus label arbitration
entries.stakes: A mislabeled motor feeder warms the Spindle service corridor. Identify the live return and isolate its overheated branch before the loom drive restarts.

entries.title: Weavers bridge seized isolator
entries.stakes: The bridge motor isolator has welded at its contacts. Keep pedestrian lift controls separated while the trapped thermal load is removed.

entries.title: Mill Ward clean supply
entries.stakes: Heat-soaked looms share the clinic supply. Compare the medical transformer rail with the factory bypass before admitting a delicate treatment load.

entries.title: Dyers archive power transfer
entries.stakes: The Dyers Exchange archive shares an overheated dye-motor feeder. Prepare an isolated records circuit without triggering the rollers nearby.

entries.title: Boiler return opening sequence
entries.stakes: A hot boiler return pump must be online before the mill gate opens; protect the motor from an early start while sampling return-water pressure.

entries.source_title: Cottonline Radio Room: Storm pulse timing
entries.title: Cottonline timed pulse
entries.stakes: The radio room motor-driven ventilation draws current in a narrow restoration window. Clear the exhaust path and synchronize the transmission pulse.

entries.title: Loomcraft cable junction repair
entries.stakes: A damaged splice beside Loomcraft Institute's overheated spindle rail threatens classroom simulators. Keep student outlets dark until the splice settles.

entries.source_title: Factory Families' Hall: Controlled load shed
entries.title: Families hall cooling priorities
entries.stakes: Shelter fans and kitchen heaters compete for a hot legacy motor feed. Reserve ventilation before accepting the nonessential meeting-hall loads.

entries.title: Ice converter beacon continuity
entries.stakes: North Ice Converter warning lamps appear lit despite an ice-crusted return conductor. Prove the actual beacon loop before reopening the quay.

entries.title: Cold Chain Pier heat allocation
entries.stakes: The pier refrigeration cabinet and ferry deicer share an inadequate supply. Keep medicine stores cold while preventing the ferry accessway from icing.

entries.source_title: Seafarers' Warming Clinic: False fuse alarm
entries.title: Warming clinic phantom fuse
entries.stakes: An icy fuse holder reports failure when the clinic warming circuit is merely under voltage. Cross-check the holder before disconnecting heaters.

entries.title: Frozen auction drain proof
entries.stakes: Meltwater from the frozen fish auction is rising into the motor controller. Drain the subfloor and prove the gallery level before restoring auction power.

entries.title: Defrost pump reversible restore
entries.stakes: An iced pump has latched after an aborted reset. Maintain drain pressure while removing the frozen thermal interlock from its restart chain.

entries.title: Breakwater dual antenna feed
entries.stakes: Sea ice bridges two antenna feed paths at the radio office. Test both channels independently and prevent a false distress acknowledgement.

entries.title: Marine school deicer restart
entries.stakes: A school substation is locked behind a frozen switch cover. Restore student safety lighting without energizing the exposed simulator rails.

entries.source_title: Harbor Heat Shelter: Network loop hunt
entries.title: Harbor shelter feedback loop
entries.stakes: Harbor Heat Shelter loses heater control through a frozen feedback conductor. Break the circulating thermostat signal before raising room temperature.

entries.title: East breaker surge pressure
entries.stakes: Wave surge holds a breaker pressure switch shut. Record the sea-front pressure and isolate the shutter motor before allowing an electrical reset.

entries.title: Jetty tram dispatch priorities
entries.stakes: The Wave Tram Jetty cannot share power with its storm shutter until the carriage is secured. Assign traction and shutter demand in a safe order.

entries.title: Coastguard contradictory monitors
entries.stakes: Surge splashes telemetry probes at the treatment room. Resolve opposing care-monitor and shore-grid readings before reconnecting backup care.

entries.title: Seawall stall access key
entries.stakes: The provision stall panel key is trapped behind a wave shutter. Verify safe shutter closure before changing its electrical access interlock.

entries.title: Surge tunnel breaker cooling
entries.stakes: A surge-tunnel motor trips its thermal protector while inlet shutters remain open. Hold the drain bypass and verify cooling before reset.

entries.title: Beacon loft crossfeed lock
entries.stakes: The Beacon Dispatch Loft has two antenna feeds joined through a stuck surge shutter controller. Break the crossfeed before sending a navigation warning.

entries.title: Tidewatch academy label correction
entries.stakes: A breaker tagged for the academy laboratory actually powers an exposed seawall shutter. Find the true feeder before students return.

entries.title: Breakwater refuge stuck blade
entries.stakes: A shelter isolator is frozen halfway while seawater loads the shutter. Protect the refuge reserve lights before freeing the blade.

entries.title: Briar hut refrigerated relay
entries.stakes: A fallen branch crushed the Briar Subgrid feeder beside a cold-food relay. Separate the cracked overhead line before transferring refrigeration.

entries.title: Orchard lift bypass isolation
entries.stakes: The orchard cargo lift is stranded beneath a fallen branch. Secure its brake circuit and isolate the debris-damaged run before using the bypass.

entries.title: Valley clinic root fault sag
entries.stakes: Treefall pulls the Valley Health Cabin supply below oxygen-circuit tolerance. Isolate the damaged branch before calibrating clinical reserves.

entries.source_title: Harvest Packing Hall: Limited cable reel
entries.title: Packing hall limited reel
entries.stakes: A short cable reel must reach the Harvest Packing Hall refrigeration controller around fallen orchard branches. Measure the run before making the joint.

entries.source_title: Briar Spring Pump: Staged pump sequence
entries.title: Briar spring staged pumping
entries.stakes: A fallen trunk blocks the spring pump suction and the relief pump lacks pressure. Prime the bypass in stages rather than forcing the jammed motor.

entries.title: Firewatch platform earth fault
entries.stakes: A broken tree branch has grounded the platform radio ladder. Confirm the mast-earth path before the fire warning transmitter is reenergized.

entries.title: Foresters school warning loop
entries.stakes: The school evacuation beacon is dark because treefall severed its return, although the nearby sign still glows. Rebuild and test the full loop.

entries.source_title: Apple Press Meeting House: Load-budget dilemma
entries.title: Apple press shelter budget
entries.stakes: The press mill and meeting-house refuge share a branch after orchard trees collapse onto the feeder. Prioritize drinking water and safe lighting.

entries.title: Kiln road archive source
entries.stakes: Ash coats the Kiln Road Junction archive supply and blocks cabinet intake filters. Isolate contaminated contacts before restoring records power.

entries.title: Rail overpass opening deadline
entries.stakes: Black Rail Overpass needs guide lights before the evacuation train arrives, but its ash filter is clogged and the controller still runs hot.

entries.source_title: Hilltop Urgent Care: Storm pulse timing
entries.title: Hilltop urgent pulse window
entries.stakes: Cinder Hill ash fouls the urgent-care ventilation relay. During the clean-air interval, deliver one timed power pulse without restarting dirty fans.

entries.title: Cinder market dry splice
entries.stakes: A blown wire at Cinder Night Market lies in an ash-covered gutter. Prevent sparks near stalls while proving the new splice under a bounded load.

entries.source_title: Ashwash Filtration Room: Controlled load shed
entries.title: Ashwash filter load shedding
entries.stakes: The filtration room has dirty ash separators on a limited bus. Shed unnecessary backwash before allocating current to emergency clean-water flow.

entries.title: Furnace signal generator choice
entries.stakes: A furnace exhaust blower competes with the evacuation repeater for emergency generator capacity. Reserve warning transmission before restarting fans.

entries.title: Miners school pressure cutout
entries.stakes: Ash-clogged intake screens trigger a false training-room pressure cutout. Compare pressure and heat readings before resetting the lab supply.

entries.title: Ridge evacuation dispatch
entries.stakes: The ridge shelter needs transport lights and breathing fans before the ash front arrives. Stage reserve power without energizing empty annex rooms.
